Services

The Services menu contains a list of user-defined Services for creating firewall rules.

If a service doesn't appear in the predefined Services list in the Firewall Rules menu, you can define the service in this menu. The new service will then appear in the Firewall Rules Services list.

Services Table

This Table lists all Services you have defined. If you have not defined any Services, the table will be empty.

To Create a Service:

  • Select Add Custom Service.
  • Enter the data for the service as required.
  • Select Apply to save the new service.

To Edit a Service:

  • Tick the radio button next to a service in the table.
  • Select Edit Service to display the service's data in the Service Definition section.
  • Change the data for the service as required.
  • Select Apply to save your changes.

To Delete a Service:

  • Tick the radio button next to a service in the table.
  • Select Delete Service to delete the selected service.
